items.title: Kroger Health Leadership Change Could Be A Game Changer For Kroger (KR)
items.summary: The Kroger Co. recently announced that Colleen Lindholz, president of Kroger Health and a 30-year company veteran, has retired after leading initiatives such as the Food as Medicine strategy and the Nourishing Change movement. Her departure raises questions about how Kroger will sustain the momentum of its health-focused initiatives that have become central to its broader retail offering. items.title: Walmart and Kroger Compete for the Same Shopper. Their Dividends Are a Different Story
items.summary: Kroger's yield triples Walmart's, but a fatter dividend check at the start can mask a fragile payout years down the road. One of these grocery giants is built to keep raising through recessions, margin squeezes, and shifting consumer habits, and it may not be the one you expect.
